Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. content_sections.heading: CSIR NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive for the Project Associate - I post is conducted by the CSIR National Institute of Oceanography (CSIR NIO), a premier research organization in India offering contract-based government opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Project Associate - I post in this recruitment notification released by the CSIR National Institute of Oceanography.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CSIR NIO Project Associate - I Recruitment 2026 is 04-10-2026. Candidates should apply early to avoid any technical glitches.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BTech/BE in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Production Engineering, Materials Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics and Automation or equivalent with NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate - I position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 31000 Per Month as per the guidelines of the project and the organization.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee is Nil for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for CSIR NIO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely online. Candidates are required to submit their application forms through the official website of CSIR NIO before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate - I post primarily involves an Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called based on their qualifications and test scores.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded directly from the Important Links section provided in this article or by visiting the official website of CSIR NIO at https://www.nio.res.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this government opening?
faq.answer: This is a contractual government job opportunity where selected candidates will be engaged for specific project durations under the CSIR National Institute of Oceanography in Goa.
